title: Site na otu mpempe gaa na nchịkọta ị nwere ike ire ere n'enweghị nsogbu

say: Site na otu mpempe gaa na nchịkọta ị nwere ike ire ere n'enweghị nsogbu.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka modul anọ nke Bead Ime na nka dị mfe: mkpokọta gị, ire ere na usoro ọzọ.
Otu akụkụ mara mma na-egosi na ị nwere ike bead. Otu obere mkpokọta na-agbanwe agbanwe na-egosi na ị nwere ike ịme azụmahịa. Ị nwere ike ime otu ihe ahụ ọzọ, na otu ọkọlọtọ, n'oge amụma.

say: Ugbu a mee ihe. Hazie mkpokọta gị wee dee kaadị ụkpụrụ gị. Mee obere ogbe ma debe ndekọ mmepụta. Hazie katalọgụ azụmahịa WhatsApp gị nwere iberibe atọ. Wee wulite Pọtụfoliyo gị wee dee atụmatụ ụbọchị 90, na-elekwasị anya otu ọnwa kwa ọnwa.
Gaa n'ihu na nkuzi ndị dị n'okpuru.
